# Brand: Zee 5
# Type: OTT Streaming Platform
# Primary Market: India & Global Indian Diaspora
# Availability: India & International Markets
# Languages Supported: Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali, Punjabi & more

> Zee 5 is an Indian over-the-top (OTT) streaming platform owned by Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited. It offers Premium Movies, TV Shows, Original Web Series, Kids content, Trending Music, Sports, FIFA World Cup and Educational programming across multiple Indian languages and global markets.
